title: 営業終了
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: RIGHT: in PEPPERMINT shop, professionally playful Minto in green/black devil outfit waves at departing Hajime, saying 「また会いに来てね♡」 LEFT: AFTER WORK outside on a quiet street, same woman now in light beige CARDIGAN, white blouse and DARK LONG SKIRT, NO horns, SAME long BLACK hair and GREEN eyes. Hajime gently says to her 「また会いたいです。」 Her professional confidence vanishes into a shy blush, small response 「……うん。」 Tiny caption 「営業終了」 at corner emphasizes the gag; do not make this a different woman.
